notes:
Context: mid-market product company building an in-app assistant + semantic search across customer docs. Recently evaluated Hosted API for quick integration; performance tests good for baseline but want Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

POC scope: 2-week Dedicated proof-of-concept targeting their primary product endpoint (short chat + rerank path). Objectives: validate p50 latency <=150ms for short prompts, stable p95 <350ms under 50 rps, KV/prefix cache behavior, and cost delta vs Hosted.

Canary + fallback plan (requested by Crestpoint):
- Canary: start at 5% traffic to Dedicated canary pool for 24h, expand to 20% if errors/latency stable. Monitoring hooks: latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, token throughput, and prompt-regression score from eval suite.
- Model variants: primary = quantized 13B open model (prod candidate), fallback-1 = 7B quantized (fast/cost-saver), fallback-2 = 3B trimmed (emergency). Routing will prefer same-architecture variants to preserve output profile.
- Region failover: primary region = us-west; secondary = eu-west for EU customers. Failover policy: automated route shift on region outage or sustained latency breach (>200ms p50 for >5m).
- Rollback policy: auto rollback to previous stable variant if error rate >2% for 10m or if eval-quality delta >5% on key prompts. SE to provide exact PromQL thresholds and alert runbook.

Security & compliance asks: SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs streamed to their SIEM, KMS integration for keys, retention policy 90 days for inference logs. Crestpoint infosec still needs SOC2 carve-out note and contractual SLA for Dedicated.

Quotes/Stake: "We like the hosted latency but need predictability and control — Dedicated looks right if cost and failover story holds."

Next concrete items: SE (Jordan) to deliver POC runbook + infra checklist by 2026-03-15. AE (Avery) to schedule infra kickoff with Crestpoint infra team for week of 2026-03-17. Procurement to start approval process for Dedicated commit once POC metrics are met.
